parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is located. 

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to obtain the region ID.
